li.label: won big at cards
li.description: Cards are a game of skill. Mostly the skill of playing people who've been drinking.

li.label: lost a bet and had to pay
li.description: I lost it fair, and the council made sure I paid. I don't have to like either part.

li.label: lost everything at cards
li.description: Double or nothing, they said. They were half right.

li.label: gambling banned
li.description: No cards, no dice. Evenings out here are just staring into the dark and listening for raiders now.

li.label: met halfway
li.description: Nobody got what they wanted. Apparently that's called fairness.

li.label: my collection was confiscated
li.description: Every one of those things was going to be useful someday. Now they're in a stockpile, where anyone can lose them.

li.label: kept my collection
li.description: They came, they looked, they left it all where it was. The council has taste.

li.label: my keepsake was broken
li.description: It was only an old thing. It was the last old thing I had.

li.label: made to apologize in public
li.description: I said sorry. Everyone watched me say it. The thing is still broken.

li.label: compensated for my loss
li.description: Silver can't replace it. Still, someone noticed it mattered.

li.label: a poor copy
li.description: They made me a new one. I keep it next to the pieces of the old one, so I can see exactly how bad it is.

li.label: a bad omen
li.description: Somebody dreamed of fire. Probably nothing. I keep sniffing the air for smoke anyway.

li.label: the council believes in dreams
li.description: We've survived this rock on sense and luck. Now we're running the place on someone's nightmares.

li.label: a good laugh
li.description: Somebody made a fool of themselves in front of everyone. I needed that.

li.label: burned our fears
li.description: We wrote our fears on scraps of wood and threw them in the fire. It felt ridiculous. I slept fine.

li.label: told to keep quiet
li.description: I saw what's coming. The council would rather not hear about it.

li.label: repaid an old kindness
li.description: Someone was good to me when they didn't have to be. Now they know I didn't forget.

li.label: couldn't repay an old kindness
li.description: They saved my life once. Whatever I owe them, it's still owed.

li.label: the council gave our things away
li.description: We scrape for every scrap, and the council sends it off to strangers.

li.label: disciplined by the council
li.description: One mistake, and now I'm hauling stone until my arms come off.

li.label: nobody's watching the gate
li.description: The night watch sleeps on duty and nothing happens about it. I'll be sleeping with one eye open.

li.label: put in charge
li.description: The council trusts me with something. I intend to be unbearable about it.

li.label: being bossed around
li.description: Give some people a little authority and they grow three sizes. Mostly in the mouth.

li.label: I have a title now
li.description: Officially important. I've started walking differently, and people have noticed.

li.label: someone got a title
li.description: Same mud, same raiders, same rations. But now one of us gets called by a title, and it isn't me.

li.label: refused a seat at the table
li.description: I offered to help run this place. They said no. Fine. I'll be watching how they do it.

li.label: sat through a council meeting
li.description: Four hours. Latrines. I've been in raids that were more fun.

li.label: they smashed my work
li.description: Art is supposed to provoke a reaction. I didn't expect the reaction to be a hammer.

li.label: my face is a joke
li.description: Every meal, there it is, grinning at me with my own crooked teeth.

li.label: a flattering likeness
li.description: They carved me heroic. My chin has never been that chin. I love it.

li.label: my music was banned
li.description: Silence at night, by order of the council. Silence, and snoring, and whatever's howling out past the walls.

li.label: watched a good fight
li.description: Blood, a loose tooth, a bit of crying at the end. Best evening in weeks.

li.label: the council stopped the fight
li.description: There was a proper way to settle it, and the council took it away. Now it'll get settled the improper way.

li.label: took what was coming
li.description: I did something terrible once. Paying for it, a little at a time, helps more than I thought it would.

li.label: settled an old score
li.description: Years I've carried that. Today I put some of it down, on their face.

li.label: used to be a raider
li.description: They burned someone's home once. Now they pass me the salt at dinner.
